column1: # AQL Language Specification: Minimal Failing Prefixes — TYPE-CHECK FAILURES (GENERATED)
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Regenerate with `make spec-gen` (specgen -frontier mode).
# A MINIMAL FAILING PREFIX is a sequence that fails while its immediate
# prefix passes — the exact atom at which a passing program first breaks.
# Every non-passing combination truncates to one of these (the trailing
# atoms after the break are discarded) and DUPLICATES ARE REMOVED, so this
# is the deduped catalogue of distinct failure points.
# Scope: prefixes drawn from combinations of length 1..3.
# These prefixes FAIL THE TYPE CHECKER: `aql check` reports at least one
# error-severity diagnostic. Because the compiler runs the checker first
# (lang.(*AQL).CompileCheck), every prefix here is also refused by the
# compiler — none is ever lowered to bytecode.
